attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 (uid/gid 1000) and applied a PAM limits config at /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf setting nofile (open files) to 8192 and nproc (processes) to 256, both soft and hard. Verified via a login shell (`su -l appworker`) that ulimit -n reports 8192 and ulimit -u reports 256. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a deferred `systemctl reboot` so the ack returned before disconnection, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce), and re-verified post-restart that the appworker account, its limits config file, and its effective login-session ulimits (8192 files / 256 processes) all persisted correctly.
